# Basalt

> Build with Basalt: an open-source React UI library with matte components, charts, and dashboard templates. TypeScript, light and dark themes, MIT licensed.

Basalt is the matte React design system `@nocoo/basalt` and its public catalog.
Public pages welcome search engines and AI crawlers. This file, the sitemap,
the Markdown endpoints, and the catalog list do not require JavaScript.

## Markdown Retrieval

Fetch raw Markdown directly instead of scraping HTML:
- Component pages: `https://basaltui.com/ui/<slug>.md`
- Category overviews: `https://basaltui.com/ui/overview/<category>.md`
- Application templates: `https://basaltui.com/templates/<slug>.md`
- [UI index (Markdown)](https://basaltui.com/ui.md): All 81 components grouped by category
- [Templates index (Markdown)](https://basaltui.com/templates.md): All 7 page templates
- [Markdown route catalog](https://basaltui.com/md-catalog.json): Machine-readable index of all Markdown routes

## Agent Entrypoints

- [Agent rules snippet](https://basaltui.com/agents.md): Drop-in `<!-- basalt:start -->` block for `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md`
- [Setup playbook](https://basaltui.com/setup.md): Step-by-step installation, CSS tokens, and provider setup
- [AI crawler policy](https://basaltui.com/ai.txt): Permissions, attribution, and scope

## Catalog

- [Design system catalog](https://basaltui.com/ui): Components, charts and blocks
- [Full catalog list](https://basaltui.com/llms-full.txt): One entry per published surface
- [Agent workspace](https://basaltui.com/templates/agent-workspace): Interactive workbench and standalone template
- [App frame](https://basaltui.com/layout): Shell, island and page heading recipe
- [Visitor login](https://basaltui.com/templates/visitor-login): Full-viewport identity badge

## Package

- npm: [@nocoo/basalt](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nocoo/basalt)
- Repository: [github.com/nocoo/basalt](https://github.com/nocoo/basalt)
- Agent usage guide (installed package): `ai/USAGE.md`
- Application chrome: `ai/INTEGRATION.md`
- Compilable recipes: `ai/RECIPES.md`
- Machine registry: `ai/registry.json`
